content:
- Ran bash .ralph/task_switch.sh after the push; it updated the Ralph summary files and sent the completion email.
- The script still emitted an rm error for missing .ralph/current_task.txt; the exact bug is already tracked at .ralph/tasks/bugs/bug-task-switch-rm-missing-current-task-file.md, so I did not create a duplicate.
- End state: requested refactor verified, committed, pushed, and Ralph switched to the next task. Remaining uncommitted changes are the expected post-switch .ralph bookkeeping plus this progress log entry.

- Read Ralph progress for codex; there was no prior visible output from the progress reader.
- Loaded the improve-code-boundaries skill and confirmed there is no pending smell file in found_smells/ beyond .gitkeep.
- Checked git status and repo tree; there are existing .ralph changes from prior task bookkeeping and I need to avoid disturbing unrelated user work.
- Next: inspect src/tests for one concrete boundary smell that reduces code, then patch it, run make lint and make test, commit including .ralph changes, push, and run task_switch.

- Proved a wrong helper per the improve-code-boundaries skill by renaming command::member_role_label and running make check.
- Compiler failures showed only two call sites, both inside StateCommandOutputDto::fmt, confirming the helper is not a real boundary.
- make check also surfaced secondary type inference fallout caused by the temporary rename; no separate bug indicated yet.
- Next: restore the helper name by replacing the helper entirely, move readiness/DCS authority rendering onto typed Display impls, simplify the command row builder, then run lint/test.

- Replaced command-layer label helpers with typed Display boundaries on DcsAuthority and Readiness, and folded role/self/readiness/trust rendering into StateCommandOutputDto::fmt.
- Removed DcsSnapshot::mode_label and DcsAuthority::label, and updated the DCS worker to log authority transitions via Display.
- Added command tests covering state output trust/readiness labels and the degraded no_quorum warning text.
- Next: run formatter, then make lint and make test, fix any issues, commit with .ralph changes, push, and task_switch.

- make lint failed only on clippy::expect-used in the new command test.
- Converted that test to return Result<(), String> and removed the expect call.
- Next: rerun formatter and make lint, then make test.

- make lint and make test both passed after the command/DCS/readiness boundary refactor.
- make test reported 240/240 passing with 5 leaky tests; those leaks are already tracked in existing Ralph bug tasks and were not introduced by this change.
- Reverted unrelated workspace-wide formatting noise from cargo fmt so the final commit stays scoped to the boundary cleanup plus required Ralph bookkeeping.
- Next: review final diff, commit, push, and run .ralph/task_switch.sh.

- Scoped boundary refactor committed as 5f0ea19 (Flatten command status label boundaries).
- Push succeeded to origin/master.
- Next: run .ralph/task_switch.sh to advance Ralph bookkeeping to the next task.
